goal: Remove MSYS launch and inherited hook-pipe races from native Python hooks (#124)
asset: Fail-closed secret decisions and advisory gate attestations on both runtimes
scope: Claude exec-form hook routing and explicit Codex legacy routing
Native Node interpreter resolution, bounded private pipes, input and deadlines
Equivalent Python attestation jurisdiction and warning-once behavior
Real runtime no-model Windows startup/timeout/orphan smoke and content pins
outOfScope: Universal cleanup of arbitrary descendants after hard launcher termination
Changing secret policy or gate exit interpretation

record.question: How should Python hooks avoid MSYS startup while preserving decisions and runtime compatibility?

options.strongest_objection: Requires Node18 and tested modern Claude exec-form support
Cached Python still starts through MSYS and can inherit hook pipes

record.rationale: Use Claude command+args to start Node directly, spawn Python shell-free with private pipes and bounded lifecycle, and retain explicit legacy Codex routing until its exec schema is verified.
evidence: Installed Claude Code2.1.312 schema and successful --init-only exec-form plugin smoke
Official Claude changelog2.1.139 adds hook args; issue124 native2.1.304 evidence bounds the upstream pipe wait

costs.cost: Native launcher, bounded adapter and platform tests
evidence: Existing Python guard and attest.record remain authoritative

costs.cost: No complete removal of MSYS launch path
evidence: Issue124 cause; current py.sh still execs native Python from Bash

requirements.statement: Claude affected hooks execute without a shell, enforce Node and tested Claude prerequisites, bound stdin/output/deadlines, keep descendant stdio private, fail closed on secret errors, preserve attest advisory warning-once, retain Codex routing and hash MJS witnesses.
requirements.counterexample: Forced launcher timeout leaves a descendant holding Claude stdout, missing interpreter permits a secret command, or Codex loses its guard

checks.scope: Native launcher lifecycle, policy parity, advisory attest and runtime-neutral manifest tests; --live additionally exercises real Claude without model calls
assumptions: PATH and explicit FPL_PY/FPL_CLAUDE_BINARY selectors are operator-owned; Windows CI observes native runtime behavior

challenges.claim: Does no MSYS layer establish that every orphan is cleaned up?
challenges.resolution: No. Private child pipes and deadline settlement prevent descendant handles from retaining hook output; forced runtime tests report cleanup independently without claiming universal descendant termination.
